response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials (a D test runner, assertion library, and C/C++ work on the LabWindows/CVI IDE), but the core requirements of this role are not met. The role demands strong Java and Kotlin expertise with deep JVM understanding plus solid Spring/enterprise framework experience; the resume lists Java only in passing on robotics and device-orchestration work over eight years ago, mentions no Kotlin, no Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate, and no JVM build-tool or application-server work. Recent experience is concentrated in TypeScript/Node.js and D. The tooling mindset and IDE curiosity are real positives, but the JVM ecosystem gap is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Demonstrated developer-tooling and IDE work (LabWindows/CVI, D test runner)
Broad polyglot systems experience including low-latency, high-throughput services
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, open-source ownership, teaching/talks
concerns: No Kotlin and only dated, peripheral Java experience
Zero evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or app-server work
Recent stack (TypeScript/Node, D) is far from JVM tooling focus
